```{r cohort sql, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(plotly)

# Unified color palette
color_palette <- c('#80CBC4', '#FFCC80', '#CE93D8', '#A5D6A7', '#90CAF9', '#F48FB1')

res_summary <- fetch_data_from_sql_file(file.path(sql_directory, "cohort_summary.sql"), yaml_file_path, release = "nov_2026")
res_demo <- fetch_data_from_sql_file(file.path(sql_directory, "demographics.sql"), yaml_file_path, release = "nov_2026")
res_coverage <- fetch_data_from_sql_file(file.path(sql_directory, "data_source_coverage.sql"), yaml_file_path, release = "nov_2026")

summary_count <- function(order) {
  res_summary %>% filter(display_order == order) %>% pull(patient_count)
}
summary_pct <- function(order) {
  res_summary %>% filter(display_order == order) %>% pull(percentage)
}

age_levels <- c("0-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-18")

# Horizontal bar chart of patient counts with percentage labels
patient_bar_chart <- function(data, label_col, title, color, top_n = 20, order_levels = NULL, record_label = NULL) {
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(label = as.character(.data[[label_col]])) %>%
    arrange(desc(patient_count)) %>%
    head(top_n)

  data$label <- if (is.null(order_levels)) {
    factor(data$label, levels = rev(data$label))
  } else {
    factor(data$label, levels = rev(order_levels))
  }

  data$customdata <- if (!is.null(record_label)) data$record_count else NA_real_

  hover_template <- "<b>%{y}</b><br>Patients: %{x:,}<br>% Patients: %{text}"
  if (!is.null(record_label)) {
    hover_template <- paste0(hover_template, "<br>", record_label, ": %{customdata:,}")
  }
  hover_template <- paste0(hover_template, "<extra></extra>")

  plot_ly(
    data,
    x = ~patient_count,
    y = ~label,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    marker = list(color = color),
    text = ~paste0(percentage, "%"),
    textposition = "outside",
    customdata = ~customdata,
    hovertemplate = hover_template
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = list(text = title, x = 0.05),
      xaxis = list(title = "Unique Patients"),
      yaxis = list(title = "", tickfont = list(size = 10)),
      margin = list(l = 200, t = 50, r = 50, b = 50)
    )
}
```

### Summary

The **Pediatric Brain Tumor Cohort** identifies patients in the November 2026 oncology OMOP dataset (IRB76049) who were diagnosed with a brain tumor between birth and 18 years of age. This cohort supports analysis of the demographics, diagnoses, and available data sources for pediatric neuro-oncology patients.

### Cohort Definition

The cohort includes patients with a qualifying condition represented by one of the following OMOP concept IDs or its descendants. The index date is the earliest qualifying condition start date, and patients must be between 0 and 18 years old (inclusive) at the index date.

| OMOP Concept ID | OMOP Concept Name | Vocabulary |
|---:|---|---|
| 373724 | Neoplasm of brain | SNOMED |
| 4239871 | Benign neoplasm of central nervous system | SNOMED |
| 4247822 | Primary malignant neoplasm of central nervous system | SNOMED |
| 36558882 | Teratoma, benign of overlapping lesion of brain and central nervous system | ICD-O |

### Patient Summary

As of November 2026, the cohort includes **`r format(summary_count(1), big.mark = ",")`** unique patients. Of these, **`r format(summary_count(4), big.mark = ",")`** (**`r summary_pct(4)`%**) have a *Primary malignant neoplasm of central nervous system* (4247822) diagnosis, **`r format(summary_count(3), big.mark = ",")`** (**`r summary_pct(3)`%**) have a *Benign neoplasm of central nervous system* (4239871) diagnosis, and **`r format(summary_count(2), big.mark = ",")`** (**`r summary_pct(2)`%**) have a *Neoplasm of brain* (373724) diagnosis. Each diagnosis includes its OMOP descendant concepts.

```{r cohort summary table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_summary %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  select(metric, patient_count, percentage) %>%
  datatable(
    colnames = c("Patient Summary", "Unique Patients", "% Patients"),
    options = list(dom = 't'),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

::: {.callout-tip}
Patients are counted once using `person_id`. The OMOP concept categories are not mutually exclusive, so a patient may be counted in more than one category. Percentages use the total pediatric brain tumor cohort as the denominator.
:::

### Demographic Summary

The demographic summaries use the pediatric brain tumor cohort as the denominator, with one row per patient within each characteristic.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Age at Index

```{r demo age, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
age_data <- res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Age at index")
patient_bar_chart(age_data, "category", "Unique Patients by Age at Index", color_palette[1],
                  order_levels = age_levels)
```

## Sex

```{r demo sex, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Sex"), "category",
                  "Unique Patients by Sex", color_palette[2])
```

## Race

```{r demo race, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Race"), "category",
                  "Unique Patients by Race", color_palette[3])
```

## Ethnicity

```{r demo ethnicity, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_demo %>% filter(characteristic == "Ethnicity"), "category",
                  "Unique Patients by Ethnicity", color_palette[4])
```

## Summary Table

```{r demo table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_demo %>%
  select(characteristic, category, patient_count, percentage) %>%
  datatable(
    colnames = c("Characteristic", "Category", "Unique Patients", "% Patients"),
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = 'ftp'),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

:::

### Data Availability

The following summaries link the pediatric brain tumor cohort to genomic, imaging, and clinical note data in the OMOP tables. A patient may have more than one test, modality, or note source, so counts across categories are not mutually exclusive.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Genomic Testing

```{r coverage genomic, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_coverage %>% filter(coverage_type == "Genomic Testing"), "data_source",
                  "Unique Patients by Genomic Test", color_palette[1], record_label = "Tests")
```

## Imaging Modality

```{r coverage imaging, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_coverage %>% filter(coverage_type == "Imaging Modality"), "data_source",
                  "Unique Patients by Imaging Modality", color_palette[5], record_label = "Images")
```

## Clinical Notes

```{r coverage notes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
patient_bar_chart(res_coverage %>% filter(coverage_type == "Clinical Notes"), "data_source",
                  "Unique Patients with Radiology or Pathology Notes", color_palette[6], record_label = "Notes")
```

## Summary Table

```{r coverage table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_coverage %>%
  select(coverage_type, data_source, patient_count, record_count, percentage) %>%
  datatable(
    colnames = c("Coverage Type", "Data Source", "Unique Patients", "Records (Tests / Images / Notes)", "% Patients"),
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = 'ftp'),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Percentages are relative to the total pediatric brain tumor cohort. Results are PHI-scrubbed and aggregated.
:::
